title: Neutralizing Popularity Bias in LLM-based Recommendation via Counterfactual Reasoning Guidelines
abstract: arXiv:2503.08051v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In the era of generative AI, recommender systems are moving from precise prediction to trustworthy generation. Large language models (LLMs) support this shift by inferring user interests and producing natural-language explanations. However, LLM-based recommendation suffers from a fundamental obstacle: popularity bias. Through pre-training on massive corpora, LLMs tend to rely on global statistics and trend signals, yielding recommendations that follow popularity rather than genuine preference. As this bias is entangled in model parameters and is hard to remove directly, we propose Neutralizing Popularity Bias in LLM-based Recommendation via Counterfactual Reasoning Guidelines (NPRec), a model-agnostic framework that mitigates popularity bias through external semantic intervention. NPRec performs counterfactual refinement to causally separate intrinsic user interests from popularity-driven conformity, producing debiased textual guidel

translated_title: 通过反事实推理指南中和基于大语言模型推荐中的流行度偏差
translated_abstract: 在生成式人工智能时代，推荐系统正从精确预测转向可信生成。大语言模型（LLMs）通过推断用户兴趣并生成自然语言解释来支持这一转变。然而，基于LLM的推荐面临一个根本性障碍：流行度偏差。由于在海量语料上进行预训练，LLM倾向于依赖全局统计和趋势信号，产生追随流行度而非真实偏好的推荐结果。由于这种偏差纠缠于模型参数之中且难以直接去除，我们提出了NPRec（通过反事实推理指南中和基于LLM推荐中的流行度偏差），这是一个模型无关的框架，通过外部语义干预来缓解流行度偏差。NPRec执行反事实细化，从因果上将用户的内在兴趣与流行度驱动的从众心理分离开来，生成去偏的文本指南
tldr: 本文提出NPRec框架，通过反事实推理进行外部语义干预，从因果上分离用户内在兴趣与流行度从众效应，生成去偏的文本指南，从而中和基于LLM推荐系统中的流行度偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes NPRec, a model-agnostic framework that neutralizes popularity bias in LLM-based recommendation by performing counterfactual refinement to causally separate intrinsic user interests from popularity-driven conformity and generate debiased textual guidelines through external semantic intervention.
